messages:
sasha: Quick heads up — we need docs + SDK regen for the console v2.4.0 release. Can teams confirm version bump PRs are green? Planning docs cutover at ~17:30 UTC. @maria @leo

maria: On it. PR #5123 bumped package.json -> 2.4.0, CI failing lint on changelog formatting (small nit).

leo: Restarted CI, flake on one test. Also opened docs PR #5124 with the changelog entry. Needs a quick proofread (section: graceful fallback policy).

todd: I'll run SDK regen after docs merge. Script: `./scripts/regen-sdk.sh --lang=ts,py`. Plan to push tag `v2.4.0-sdk` once docs are live.

sasha: Please hold tags until changelog wording is settled. @sam can you do a quick review of the changelog paragraph about fallback behavior?

sam: Reviewing now — tiny wording nit (suggest replace "fallbacks" -> "fallback policy"). Pushing a one-line commit to #5124.

maria: CI passed on #5123 and #5124. I'm doing a local docs build: `yarn workspace docs build` — staging preview looks fine except one broken image (fixed in the commit I just pushed).

deploy-bot: staging deploy started — https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/deploys/2412345678 (logs streaming)

todd: SDK regen done locally, created draft PR #5130. I need the docs prod deploy to be live before switching public import paths.

sasha: Let's hold the cutover for a short canary window until 2412345900 to let real traffic settle. If nothing odd, we cut then. @eng-oncall FYI.

docs-bot: smoke tests passed on staging (12/12). Full report: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/2412345678/smoke

maria: All green and changelog wording approved. Sasha you can proceed with cut.

leo: Merging docs PR #5124 now.

deploy-bot: docs prod deploy queued (window 18:00 UTC).

sasha: Cutting now — tagging `release/2.4.0` branch and updating release notes. Todd, after prod is live please push SDK tags and update SDK docs index.

todd: Will do. I'll run `./scripts/publish-sdks.sh --tag 2.4.0` after docs are live. Ping me in this thread when the prod link is up.

sam: Quick QA check — did we also bump the console repo version? There's PR #214 in console ready to merge.

maria: Yes, console repo bumped in #214.

leo: Prod docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/v2.4.0 (deploy id 2412345690). :tada:

todd: Starting SDK publish now.

deploy-bot: SDK publishing jobs started (job id 2412345800).

todd: SDKs published, npm packages pushed, and release artifacts uploaded. Draft release updated with SDK tarballs and checksums.

sasha: Thanks everyone. I'll mark the release checklist item complete. If any regressions pop up, we can roll back to 2.3.8. Please file any post-release bugs in the release board and ping the thread.
